user.title: ONVIF User Manager
user.description: Choose how to set up this integration.

device.title: Camera credentials
device.description: Enter the camera's ONVIF credentials (the password you set via the :80 SOAP SetUser / ONVIF Device Manager). The native integration talks straight to the camera, no browser involved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the camera (check host/port).

abort.no_options: This entry only registers the standalone services and has nothing to configure.

list_users.name: List ONVIF users
list_users.description: List all ONVIF users on a camera (pass host + management account).

modify_user.name: Modify ONVIF user
modify_user.description: Change a user's level and/or password. Some cameras require both password and level when changing either, so it's safest to always provide both. Provide at least one of target_password / level.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Edit the camera connection parameters. Saving reloads the integration immediately. Leave the password blank to keep the current one (no need to re-type it when only changing IP / username).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the camera (check host/port).
